from: Recorded 2026-11-12 from Aave V3's USDC pool on an anvil fork of Base at block 56115270, as eth_estimateGas answered for a key that never held real money (its USDC was written into the token's balance slot on the fork). Aave's ACL admin made an emergency admin, which paused the USDC reserve; then a supply of 1M USDC was asked.
